# 3rd-party / ck_dsl_kernels

Pre-built HSACO code objects generated by the ck_dsl prototype
([ROCm/rocm-libraries `users/vanantha/ck-dsl-prototype` branch,
`projects/composablekernel/python/ck_dsl/`](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/tree/users/vanantha/ck-dsl-prototype/projects/composablekernel/python/ck_dsl)),
checked in directly so the EP can load them via `hipModuleLoadData` without a
build-time dependency on ck_dsl itself.

Each subdirectory is named for the AMDGPU target the HSACO was compiled for
(`gfx1151`, `gfx942`, ...). Inside, files are named `<op>.hsaco` and pair
with a `<op>.manifest.json` carrying the kernel symbol name, ABI signature,
block size, and the ck_dsl `KernelArtifact.timings` from the build.

## Currently shipped

| File | Op | Target | Source | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`gfx1151/wmma_fmha_decode.hsaco`](gfx1151/wmma_fmha_decode.hsaco) | GQA single-pass FMHA decode, B=1, H=32, G=8, d=128, fp16 | gfx1151 (Strix Halo) | `ck_dsl.instances.gfx1151.wmma_fmha_fwd::WmmaFmhaFwdSpec(head_size=128, num_query_heads=32, num_kv_heads=8, mask_mode="none")` | `lib/Runtime/real/ck_dsl_fmha_decode.cpp` (gated behind `HIPDNN_EP_CK_DSL_FMHA_DECODE=1`) |

## Rebuilding

The HSACO is regenerated from the ck_dsl prototype branch. On a gfx1151 host
with `HIP_PATH` pointing at a ROCm 7.x dist:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries.git
cd rocm-libraries
git checkout users/vanantha/ck-dsl-prototype
git sparse-checkout init --cone
git sparse-checkout set projects/composablekernel/python/ck_dsl
git checkout
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD/projects/composablekernel/python

python -c "
from ck_dsl.helpers import compile_kernel
from ck_dsl.instances.gfx1151.wmma_fmha_fwd import (
    WmmaFmhaFwdSpec, build_wmma_fmha_fwd,
)
spec = WmmaFmhaFwdSpec(
    head_size=128, num_query_heads=32, num_kv_heads=8, mask_mode='none'
)
art = compile_kernel(build_wmma_fmha_fwd(spec, arch='gfx1151'), arch='gfx1151')
open(f'{art.kernel_name}.hsaco', 'wb').write(art.hsaco)
print(art.kernel_name, art.hsaco_bytes)
"
```

Then re-run [`scripts/embed_hsaco.py`](../../scripts/embed_hsaco.py) against
the new HSACO file to regenerate
`lib/Runtime/real/ck_dsl_fmha_decode_gfx1151_hsaco.h`.

## Why pre-built instead of building ck_dsl in CI

ck_dsl is a Python prototype that codegens via `libamd_comgr` in-process. It
does not currently ship as a build-time dependency (no PyPI release, no
vendored copy in this tree). Pre-building the HSACO on a known-good ck_dsl
revision and checking it in is the lowest-friction path until the prototype
graduates. The `manifest.json` records exactly which spec produced the
artifact for reproducibility.

When ck_dsl ships as a normal dependency, this directory can become a
build-time `add_custom_command` target instead of a check-in.
